map.计算专利、商标、著作权的保护期届满日与剩余年限，提示续展/缴费时间节点。: Compute the expiry date and remaining years of protection for patents, trademarks and copyrights, and flag renewal or fee payment deadlines.
map.发明专利：申请日 2010-03-01，保护期 20 年自申请日起算，届满日 2: Invention patent: filing date 2010-03-01, protection term 20 years counted from the filing date, expiring 2030-03-01; annual fees must be paid each year to maintain it, and the patent right terminates if the fees are not paid.
map.注册商标：核准注册日 2018-06-15，保护期 10 年，届满 2028-0: Registered trademark: approved registration date 2018-06-15, protection term 10 years, expiring 2028-06-15; renewal period 2027-06-15 to 2028-06-15, grace period until 2028-12-15.
map.外观设计：2022-01-01 申请（2021-06-01 之后），保护期 15: Design: filed 2022-01-01 (after 2021-06-01), protection term 15 years, expiring 2037-01-01; those filed earlier get 10 years.
map.算例：发明专利 20 年保护期: Example: 20-year protection term for an invention patent
map.：申请日 2010-03-01，发明专利保护期 20 年，届满日 = 2010-: : Filing date 2010-03-01, invention patent protection term 20 years, expiry = 2010-03-01 + 20 years = 2030-03-01. If today is 2024-06-10, about 2090 days remain (about 5.7 years). Trademarks differ: approved registration date 2018-06-15 + 10 years = expiry 2028-06-15, and renewal can be filed within the 12 months before expiry (from 2027-06-15), each renewal adding 10 years.
map.外观设计为何有 10 年与 15 年之分？: Why do designs have both a 10-year and a 15-year term?
map.2021 年 6 月 1 日第四次修正《专利法》施行后申请的外观设计专利保护期为: After the Fourth Amendment to the Patent Law took effect on June 1, 2021, design patents filed afterwards are protected for 15 years, while those filed earlier get 10 years; the distinction is whether the filing date falls after 2021-06-01.
map.商标到期不续展会怎样？: What happens if a trademark is not renewed on expiry?
map.期满未续展且错过 6 个月宽展期的，注册商标失效，他人可申请注册；续展应在期满前: If renewal is not completed on expiry and the 6-month grace period is missed, the registered trademark lapses and others may apply to register it; renewal should be filed within the 12 months before expiry, and can be made up with an extra fee during the grace period.
